title: Northwell Digital Alliances - Outreach Scrapbook
content:
Topline: quick scratchbook for outreach to Northwell (regional health system). Goal = pilot for patient-facing triage assistant + clinician note summarization; low-risk, measurable pilot (30k visits/month scope).

Who/why:
- Primary champion hypothesis: Dir. of Digital Strategy / VP of Care Transformation (need names).
- Secondary: informatics lead + security/compliance; SRE for integration.
- Value props to highlight: predictable latency at scale (scheduling/triage spikes), private deployment option (VPC/on-prem), audit logs/KMS for PHI handling, cost savings vs building in-house.

Quick research notes (from LinkedIn/company site):
- Northwell has a Digital Transformation org, recent hiring for "Head of Clinical AI" (may be relevant).
- Announced region-wide virtual triage pilot in late 2025 — likely targets patient messaging and symptom checkers.
- Enterprise SSO & strict data residency policies; often prefers vendor with HIPAA BAAs and VPC options.

Outbound sequence (drafts):
1) Short cold email (subject A): "Reduce triage response times for virtual urgent care — quick win?"
   - Hi <Name>,
   - Quick note: Redwood Inference helps teams run high-quality LLM features with predictable latency and HIPAA-friendly private deployment. We recently helped a regional system reduce triage latency by 60% during peak hours via aggressive caching + batching.
   - Would love 15 minutes to see if a small pilot (2 clinics, 4 weeks) makes sense.
   - — Elena

2) Alternate subject (B): "Pilot idea: clinician note summaries that save 3–7 min/visit"
   - Short callout of numbers + ask for 20-min intro with informatics + security.

3) LinkedIn touch: one-liner referencing mutual connection or recent Northwell announcement; ask to introduce to Care Transformation lead.

Call script (30s elevator + 5-min opener):
- Elevator (30s): "Hi <Name>, Elena with Redwood — we help health systems put LLMs in front of patients and clinicians with predictable cost and privacy controls (private control plane, KMS, audit logs). We run on dedicated pools so you don't get noisy neighbor spikes during flu season."
- Diagnosis questions: "What's your current triage/virtual intake stack? How often do you see peak bursts? Any concerns about hallucinations / auditability?"
- Close: propose a 20-min technical + compliance intro next week.

Objection handling (quick bullets):
- "We’re worried about PHI": Redwood Private + BAA + optional on-prem package. We can run entire inference in their VPC with customer-managed keys; provide audit logs and token-level redaction guidelines.
- "We already have a partner": ask what’s missing (latency, costs, SLAs, observability). Offer a short, no-risk pilot to quantify differences (latency & cost per triage flow).
- "Cost concerns": show cost controls (batching, KV caching, quantization suggestions) and a pilot pricing proposal capped for duration. Emphasize predictable billing for Dedicated pools.
- "Model quality / hallucinations": share evals, prompt-set regression monitoring, automatic rollback to conservative model variant. Offer custom prompt templates and guided deployment to clinician-approved outputs.

Pilot proposal (sketch):
- Scope: 2 urgent care clinics, patient intake chat + clinician note summarization for new visits.
- Duration: 4 weeks (1 week setup, 3 weeks live).
- Success metrics: median triage response latency < 800ms, clinician note time saved >= 3 min/visit, error rate (critical hallucinations) < 0.5% in sampled audits.
- Data flows: inbound patient text -> private inference endpoint in customer VPC -> optional KV cache for common prefixes -> audit log exported to SIEM. No raw transcripts stored outside customer environment unless explicitly opted in.

Technical quicknotes (for SE convo):
- Likely stack: integrate via Redwood hosted SDK or deploy Redwood Private in VPC. If they prefer on-prem, we have air-gapped package but needs ops lead and ~3–4 weeks prep.
- Auth: support for OIDC + mutual TLS for service-to-service.
- KMS: integrate with AWS KMS / Google KMS / Azure Key Vault.
- Observability: token-level telemetry, per-route latency histograms, error traces.
- Fallback strategy: serve smaller quantized model in Dedicated pool under high load (cost/latency tradeoff).

Pricing/contract talking points:
- Start with time-limited pilot with capped monthly commit for Dedicated pool (min viable to guarantee <800ms p95).
- Offer credit toward first month of Dedicated if they convert to 6+ month commitment.

Notes to self / research TODOs: (high priority)
- Find Head of Clinical AI name + email (LinkedIn search: "Head of Clinical AI Northwell"; check conference roster).
- Pull any press on the 2025 triage pilot and cite (date + link).
- Ask Legal for example BAA language and short FAQ for PHI handling.
- Sync with SE: can we guarantee 800ms p95 for 30k visits/month with a 4-GPU Dedicated pool? Jonah to validate.

Lower-priority outreach ideas:
- Co-host webinar with Northwell digital leads: "Operationalizing clinical LLMs: safety, latency, cost" — invite product marketing.
- Reminder: mention Redwood Optimize (batching/quantization recs) as a distinct selling point for cost-sensitive teams.

Draft calendar of next steps:
- 2026-03-11: quick intro email sent to generic Digital Strategy alias (status: queued). Owner: Elena.
- 2026-03-12: LinkedIn message to Head of Clinical AI (once identified). Owner: Elena.
- 2026-03-13: internal sync with Jonah + Priya (prep SE/Legal pack). Owner: Elena + Jonah.
- 2026-03-18: follow-up call if no reply. Owner: Elena.

Quick stash of suggested email snippets to A/B test (short):
- A: "15 min? Pilot to cut triage latency and clinician note time"
- B: "Can we show you a measurable reduction in triage wait times in 3 weeks?"
- C: "We handle PHI: private deployment + audit logs. Pilot idea inside."

Internal signals to escalate to AE/SE:
- Exec intro granted
- Interest from Informatics + Security in running a compliance review
- Willingness to run a scoped pilot with live patient traffic

End notes: rough, keep this doc as living scratchpad. When we get one warm intro, convert to Partner Opportunity page in Confluence and attach pilot SLA template + cost worksheet.

Random thoughts / reminders:
- Use conservative language on "AI" in external outreach (Northwell seems conservative). Use terms: "LLM-powered services", "automated summarization", "virtual triage assistant".
- Prep a one-pager that lists exact data residency & BAAs details; send it with intro email if asked.
